just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on B3 and dwells most on Gb in Phrase 1. Phrase 4 (0:24.1) introduces E, G, centred on E. Phrase 6 (0:54.1) introduces A, centred on G. The line peaks at A4 (439.5 Hz) at 0:57.6. It closes on G4, not the tonic (G4 → G4 → G4 → A4 → Gb4 → G4).
